responsibility: Defines unit tests for the `small_str` module, validating `SmallStr`’s observable behavior for empty construction and iterator-based string collection, including whether data remains inline or spills to heap storage based on capacity.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `small_c_str/tests.rs`, this file covers plain `SmallStr` behavior—empty construction and iterator collection across the inline/spill boundary—without any NUL-termination or `CStr` interoperability concerns.
